arguments.cover_letter:
You need live chat inside our existing app for your real estate business, and the projects below are the closest matches from my portfolio.

On Fleet tracking live map for a logistics client I used React, WebSockets, Node.js and streamed positions for 1,200 vehicles with sub-second lag.

On Team chat widget for a SaaS client I used WebSockets, Node.js, Redis and handled 8,000 concurrent connections in load tests.

On Checkout redesign for an e-commerce client I used React, Stripe and raised checkout completion from 61% to 74%.

I can start this week. Would a 20 minute call suit you to confirm scope and milestones?
screening_answers: The closest match is Fleet tracking live map, where I streamed positions for 1,200 vehicles with sub-second lag.
